note: plate length doubled; dependent plate and hole offsets propagated with wrong arithmetic, one hole offset not moved
instruction: Set each flange plate length equal to twice the plate width; the twist segment, plate thickness, and hole pattern (relative to plate ends) stay the same.

note: bevel built as a lofted hexagon intersection instead of a 30-degree chamfer; close but not the same solid
instruction: Bevel the six straight outer edges of the top face at 30 degrees from horizontal, 2 mm wide on the top.

note: exact 9.4/3 versus the reference rounded to 3.133; IoU 1.0000 at four decimals, just under the strict threshold
instruction: Set the small-end outer radius equal to one third of the big-end outer radius; the shank, big-end bore, and counterbore stay the same.

note: union chain inserted after a completed statement; patch invalid
instruction: Add a small flat round boss on top of the central hub, 16 mm in diameter and 3 mm thick, centered on the central axis above the existing tapered top of the hub.

note: outer radius = 3x inner applied as a linear rescale of every profile point, reference changes only the peak radii
instruction: Set the outer radius equal to three times the inner radius; the number of convolutions and convolution height stay the same.

note: hexagonal recess placed with workplane() inside the build chain instead of the bounding-box centre after it
instruction: Add a centered hexagonal blind recess on the top face of the tapered knob, with a 4.00 mm size and a 5.43 mm depth.

note: chamfer on every +Z edge fails in the kernel; no solid
instruction: Add a 45-degree chamfer to all top edges of the connecting rod. The chamfer width equals half the small-end bore radius. The base geometry, big-end through-hole, and small-end bore are unchanged.

note: reference also deletes the central bore that the instruction says stays; Astra keeps it
instruction: Remove the upper hemispherical end cap (the sphere at +Z); the cylinder body, the lower hemispherical cap at -Z, and the central bore stay the same. The result is a flat-topped half-capsule.

note: cap union inserted mid-chain, so later operations also act on it
instruction: Add a round flat cap on top of the knob, 8 mm in diameter and 1.5 mm thick, centred on the central axis and sitting flush above the existing top face.

note: patch identical to the reference program; released reference STEP is invalid
instruction: Rotate the entire part by 90° about the X axis.

note: ring placed at y=49 and extruded one-sided instead of centred at mid-height y=23.5
instruction: Add a flat annular ring around the mid-height of the bellows, with outer radius 35 mm, inner radius 26 mm, and thickness 6 mm, lying flat against the central waist.

note: inlet radius changed and the opposite wall point moved too (123.2 to 153.2); profile breaks
instruction: Increase the inlet-end outer radius from 100.0 mm to 130.0 mm, changing the upstream outer wall from a straight cylindrical section to a tapered conical section.

note: cross arms rebuilt as four corner-to-corner arcs; straight arm sides lost
instruction: Modify the original cross-shaped CAD part by replacing the four rectangular protrusions with semicircular rounded protrusions, where each arc has a diameter equal to the original protrusion width.

note: height changed and raised face and neck moved down to stay attached; instruction says they stay
instruction: Set the outer cylinder height equal to half the outer radius; the bolt holes, raised face, and neck stay the same.

note: instruction says cut a slot but the reference removes the existing slot; Astra returns no edit
instruction: Cut a centered obround blind slot into the top face of the upper cylindrical section, with a length of 18.16 mm, a width of 6.81 mm, and a depth of 7.06 mm.

note: rotation inserted mid-chain, before later features, instead of rotating the finished part
instruction: Rotate the entire part by 60 degrees about the axis (1, 1, 0).

note: boss placed on the centre of mass of the +X-most top face, not the part centre
instruction: Add a raised round boss centered on the top face of the locator block, 30 mm in diameter and 14 mm tall, sitting flush above the existing top and flanking the rectangular pocket.

note: 2 x across-flats computed correctly (15.012 x sqrt 3 = 26.0); reference uses 2 x circumscribed diameter (30.0)
instruction: Set the standoff height equal to twice the across-flats size; the bore and hex profile stay the same.

note: throat radius reduced and the inner wall moved to keep thickness; reference changes the outer points only
instruction: Reduce the throat radius from 58.7 mm to 40.0 mm, decreasing the throat diameter from 117.4 mm to 80.0 mm.

note: no parsable patch
instruction: Add 3 extra bolt through-passages to each of the two flat end plates, so each plate now has a 2 by 2 grid of 4 bolt holes of 6.5 mm diameter, evenly arranged on the plate around its existing single hole.

note: instruction adds a dome but the reference deletes the existing spherical cut; Astra adds a hemisphere
instruction: On the top, add a spherical dome of 5.5 mm radius centered on the central axis.

note: holes drilled along Y (XZ workplane) instead of through the wide faces along Z
instruction: Drill 4 round through-passages of 4 mm diameter through the flat middle section of the rod, in a single straight line at 25 mm, 40 mm, 55 mm, and 70 mm along the length, perpendicular to the wide flat faces.

note: polygon radius 9.08 read as diameter 18.16 (CadQuery polygon takes a diameter); reference uses 9.08 directly
instruction: Add a centered hexagonal blind recess on the top face, with a polygon radius of 9.08 mm and a depth of 8.00 mm.

note: cross-hole heights shifted by half a step height (frame assumption); direction X versus Y
instruction: Add 2 round cross-holes of 8 mm diameter through the middle thicker step of the shaft, both perpendicular to the central axis, at 25 mm and 45 mm from the bottom face of the shaft.

note: instruction says 33 mm; reference hole is 33.4 mm (radius 16.70)
instruction: Drill a 33 diameter through-hole along the Z axis.

note: removes the requested hole and a second, existing 32.9 mm hole
instruction: Remove a 33 diameter through-hole along the Z axis.

note: patch identical to the reference program; released STEP differs from that program
instruction: Remove the centered hexagonal blind recess on the top face of the tapered knob.

note: reference slot is not longer and not re-centred; Astra lengthens it and re-centres it
instruction: Change the straight rectangular key body into a longer rounded slot-shaped body with semicircular ends, while keeping other parameters unchanged.

note: obround recess placed with workplane() inside the chain, off the reference centre
instruction: Add a centered obround blind recess on the top face of the tapered knob, with a length of 10.00 mm, a width of 3.00 mm, and a depth of 4.34 mm.

note: top convolution removed with a different end profile than the reference
instruction: Remove the topmost convolution of the bellows so it has four peaks instead of five; the bottom and the lower four convolutions stay the same.

note: patch identical to the reference program; released STEP differs from that program
instruction: Remove the centered obround blind recess on the top face of the tapered knob.

note: height changed and raised face and neck moved up to stay attached; reference leaves them in place
instruction: Increase the height of the main flange body from 22.90 mm to 29.77 mm.

note: instruction gives 18 x 7 x 7; reference uses 18.16 x 6.81 x 7.06
instruction: Cut a 18×7 slot 7 deep into the top face.

note: deletion span off by one workplane call; remaining hole rows inherit the 1.5 mm centre offset
instruction: Remove the central rectangular through-cut and the vertical-edge fillet. The two mounting-hole rows on the top face are kept.

note: instruction says 21 mm; reference hole is 20.98 mm
instruction: Drill a 21 diameter through-hole along the Z axis.
